title: Grey Gaels hoodie left in the stand
body: Age 11-12 size, name tag says 'Cara'. It is behind the bar in the clubhouse, ask for Marie.

title: Two seats going to the U16 game in Rathcoole
body: Leaving the clubhouse car park at half five on the Saturday. Two seats free, first come first served.

title: Stewards needed for the championship quarter-final
body: We need six more stewards for the gate and the car park. No experience needed, briefing is 45 minutes before throw-in.

title: Camogie gear order closes on Friday
body: Last call for the winter half-zip order. Sizes 8 to 18 and youth sizes. Order form is in the clubhouse.

title: Set of car keys found at Tymon Park North
body: Found near the Limekiln Road gate after Sunday training. Toyota fob with a green keyring.
